title: Who finished third?
blurb: A race-order puzzle with exactly one solution (checked by computer).
question: Five runners (Ana, Bo, Cy, Di and Ed) finish a race with no ties. Clues: 1) Ana finished before Bo. 2) Cy finished immediately after Di. 3) Ed did not finish first or last. 4) Bo finished after Cy. 5) Ana finished before Di. 6) Ed finished before Cy. Who finished third?

5. **A < D** (Ana finished before Di)
